slides.headline: Cast, Hero Subject & Wardrobe Polarity
slides.narrative_copy: Product-led hero subject: Defines the exact cardboard texture, proportions, blue-printed IKEA logo, and packing tape styling of the sealed flat-pack box.. Strict material polarity lock enforced across all cuts.

slides.headline: Master Environment — Minimalist Stockholm Loft
slides.narrative_copy: An expansive 8x6 meter open-plan apartment with ultra-smooth pale blonde ash hardwood floors, matte-white limewashed walls, and floor-to-ceiling multi-pane Nordic windows on the left wall looking out to quiet birch trees. Lighting: Soft, low-angled morning Scandinavian sunlight streaming through the windows at 5200K daylight balance, casting elongated warm rectangular light pools across the floor, filled with soft 6500K ambient room bounce. Atmosphere: Delicate, slow-drifting micro-motes of atmospheric dust illuminated in the light beam; zero haze, zero smoke. Invariants: The pale blonde ash floorboards remain mechanically rigid with realistic wood grain that never distorts or changes direction.; The walls remain pristine matte-white with consistent architectural baseboards.; All furniture pieces retain exact Scandinavian minimalist geometry and color-true IKEA fabrics once assembled.

slides.headline: SC01: The Awakening Box
slides.narrative_copy: The sealed IKEA box sits dead-center on the bare ash floor in total stillness under morning sunlight. -> At second 03, the box begins to shudder rapidly with high-frequency tactile micro-vibrations. -> At second 07, the reinforced packing tape along the top center seam suddenly splits open with a crisp pop and a tiny puff of kraft paper dust. Kinetic Chain: Stillness -> Micro-oscillation of box edges against ash floorboards -> High-tension seam split -> Cardboard flaps spring open 15 degrees -> Settles into open posture.

slides.headline: SC02: The Hyper-Kinetic Self-Assembly
slides.narrative_copy: The cardboard flaps fold flat onto the floor like blooming origami petals. -> Precision-cut solid oak furniture legs, white shelf panels, and frame components levitate out in structured order. -> Components interlock at high velocity into a low coffee table and a minimalist shelving unit with rigid mechanical clicks. Kinetic Chain: Flaps burst outward -> Wooden pieces slide on air trajectories -> Dovetail joints collide and snap together -> Base legs strike the hardwood floor with solid acoustic thuds -> Stable resting lock.

slides.headline: SC03: Upholstery & Soft Architecture
slides.narrative_copy: A textured grey fabric sofa expands smoothly from the center staging area, cushions billowing outward. -> A woven natural wool area rug unrolls across the ash floor with rhythmic momentum. -> A ceramic table lamp and a potted green fiddle-leaf fig slide gracefully onto their finished surfaces. Kinetic Chain: Rug unrolls across floorboards with surface friction -> Sofa cushions drop under gravity -> Potted plant bases contact oak tabletop with ceramic clinks -> Secondary leaf settling oscillation.

slides.headline: SC04: The Final Flourish & The ASMR Stillness
slides.narrative_copy: A folded mustard-yellow waffle-knit wool throw blanket arcs gracefully through the air over the sofa. -> The blanket lands dead-center on the grey sofa corner, sending a soft, visible air ripple through its knit folds. -> All motion abruptly freezes into an immaculate, serene, fully furnished architectural living room. Kinetic Chain: Throw blanket trajectory -> Gentle gravitational descent -> Impact with sofa cushion -> Micro-compression of textile knit -> Total static equilibrium.

slides.headline: Sonic Architecture & BGM Arc — Nordic Serenity: Tactile Pulse
slides.subhead: Minimalist Acoustic Neo-Classical ASMR · 84 BPM · D Major
slides.narrative_copy: Dynamic Arc: Seconds 00-08: Tense, playful pizzicato rhythm ticking like a clockwork box. Seconds 08-16: Rapid, polyrhythmic wooden mallet pulses synchronizing with furniture clicks. Seconds 16-24: Swelling warm cello and piano harmony. Seconds 24-32: All music decrescendos instantly on the final blanket drop, leaving only a sustained pure piano chord and serene silence. | Diegetic Foley: Low resonant cardboard vibration on wood floor; Sharp, satisfying high-frequency tape tear and cardboard seam pop; Crisp wood dowel clicks, rapid mechanical drawer slide swooshes, and solid pine locking thuds; Soft, airy, deep 'fwoomp' of down-filled textiles settling onto wood | Room Acoustics: Bright, reverberant empty wooden room acoustics during the initial box opening, transitioning smoothly into a warm, dampened, acoustically insulated soundscape as fabrics, rugs, and cushions populate the space. | Stems: percussion: Rhythmic pulse and transient acoustic hits, bass: Sub-harmonic foundation and low-end drone, harmony: Mid-range chord progression and ambient pads, lead: Hero melodic motif or lead arpeggio
